texts.Problem:HostImpersonation.Title: Host impersonation denied
Host tenant-impersonation is not configured on this server. Add a project reference to Granit.MultiTenancy.Authorization and call AddGranitHostImpersonationWithPermissions() to enable it.
texts.Problem:HostImpersonation.PermissionDeni: The authenticated host operator does not have the MultiTenancy.Host.Impersonate permission required to act in a tenant scope.
texts.Problem:TenantMismatch.Title: Tenant context mismatch
texts.Problem:TenantMismatch.Detail: The tenant resolved from the request (header or query string) does not match the tenant claim carried by the access token.
